prose: Life expectancy shows less top-ten stability than GDP per capita, where five of the same year's top ten persist. Only {{overlapCount}} of {{firstYear}}'s life expectancy top ten remain: {{overlapList}}. The countries that now lead are a mix of small high-income states and Gulf economies that also rank high in internet penetration and income per person.

The global median rose from {{medianFirstYearFmt}} years in {{firstYear}} to {{medianLatestFmt}} years in {{latestYear}}, a gain that is larger in absolute terms than the movement at the top of the table, where the leaders were already above 70 years in {{firstYear}}.

Rankings are computed among all countries with reported data for each year. Countries with no reported value in a given year are excluded from that year's ranking. The ranking uses the World Bank's single estimate for life expectancy at birth, combining both sexes.

faq.q: How often is this data updated?
faq.a: The World Bank publishes updated life expectancy estimates annually. This page is rebuilt from the latest release, retrieved {{retrievedAtHuman}}.

methodology: Figures are life expectancy at birth in years as published in the {{sourceLink}} (indicator SP.DYN.LE00.IN), retrieved {{retrievedAtHuman}}. The measure combines both sexes. Rankings are computed among all countries with reported data for each year; countries with no reported value in a given year are excluded from that year's ranking. Trajectory sparklines index each country's series to its own {{firstYear}}–{{latestYear}} range and are not comparable in level across rows.
